authors: Tristano Sainati, Giorgio Locatelli, Nigel Smith, Naomi Brookes, Gordon Olver
definition: 'Project governance defines both the organisational structures and processes to govern the project... assigning project roles and responsibilities' (p. 244).
stakeholders: Holders of 'a legal, or contractual, claim'; SPVs cluster stakeholders; lenders control.
temporality_detail: Minimal - SPV 'liquidated when... functions... accomplished' (p. 252). Does not treat temporality.
gaps: The durable contractual/SPV layer against which cyclical metagovernance could be contrasted.
key_quotes: 'Project governance defines both the organisational structures and processes to govern the project... assigning project roles and responsibilities to project stakeholders' (p. 244).
coding_notes: Represents the static formal-instrument end of the spectrum.
